label: plan12.14-q-paid
authorization: the operator's paid Q release: the release file `--release` names (the released head, evaluation contract v15's digest and both review comment links on #548), one launch only; a stopped run is not relaunched without a new operator decision
capacity: as reports/plan12-memory-m2b/gate-config.json: five live indexes, 96,763 records, about 563 MiB; 1,024 MiB leaves about 1.8x headroom
models: the paid rows go only to the operator-started Gateway (OPTIMUS_GATEWAY_URL, OPTIMUS_API_KEY); the dry pass to a loopback stub; the index Gateway's upstream is unroutable (127.0.0.1:9); m2b_launch refuses with a provider key in its own environment
teardown: m2b_launch.provisioned closes every session, the index Gateway and removes the container and volume in a finally block, confirming their removal
